title: The broken piano and how musicians are chosen
summary: Bull objects to the out-of-tune piano with broken strings despite the nightly take, and to hiring favourites and threatening musicians who play elsewhere.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
